title.narrative: 1: Improved national institutional capacities to support participatory and accountable fiscal decentralization

description.narrative: As at 2021, all counties had shown a remarkable improvement in technical and professional capacities on areas such as FSFM and other aspect of county planning and development. The lessons learnt have since been cascaded to other levels of county governments planning, budgeting, resource allocation and utilization, impacting quite positively in the growth and development of the beneficiary counties.

title.narrative: 2: Increased capacity at the National government level to support County governments to facilitate participatory planning, and local economic development

description.narrative: Even though MoDA had significantly increased its capacities in the areas of providing increased support to counties in good governance, participatory planning, LED and civic education, still there emerged certain gaps such as assisting counties to come up with legally workable Legal Frameworks for various LED Projects. This affected the smooth transfer of completed projects to the final beneficiaries for purposes of operationalization

title.narrative: 4: 17 County IDEAS LED projects are successfully implemented and operational

description.narrative: To date 70% of LED objectives have been achieved. Only two of the LED projects (Uasin Gishu and Kwale) were complete and operational as at the reporting time however, one of this (Kwale) was affected by a court action that led to it being served by a temporary court injunction. Fifteen (15) other projects are in the process of completion and winding up.

title.narrative: 3: Increased capacity at the County level to facilitate participatory planning, and local economic development

description.narrative: To date, All 15 counties have increased capacities to facilitate participatory planning, and local economic development. Evidence of this achievement was obtained from the Project minutes, records of works and site meetings conducted and facilitated between the Project Contractors, Project Management Committees and the County Government Officers on the one hand and with the Community Stakeholders on the other hand.
